bb96fd28e0bafa2db7255616f0e09699.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Visits Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations under Construction
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 3 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, gave field guidance at the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations under construction.
Comrade Kim Jong Un was accompanied by senior officials of the Central Committee of the WPK and officials of the designing and creation institutions.
The construction of the memorial museum of combat feats is progressing at 97 percent of the total project.

Comrade Kim Jong Un learnt about the finishing project of the museum and arrangement and exhibition of the contents of combat feats and installation of sculptures and symbolic memorials and highly appreciated them.

Saying that the museum will be a monument to the era praising the great heroism of the proud sons of the DPRK and a seat for education in patriotism, he added that a ceremony of burying the remains of the martyrs there would be solemnly held in mid-April and the museum be inaugurated with due ceremony on the occasion of the first anniversary of the concluded operations for liberating Kursk.
That day he ratified a plan for attaching the museum to a relevant department of the General Political Bureau of the Korean People's Army. -0-

befc90c1d42a1b4d26e2873f32e8433c.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Inspects Service Facilities in Fourth-Stage District of Hwasong Area Nearing Inauguration
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 3 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, went around various service facilities in the fourth-stage district of the Hwasong Area nearing their inauguration in order to learn about the preparations for their operation.

The new street in the Hwasong Area, successfully turned into a symbol of high civilization in our era under the grand capital city construction plan and energetic guidance of the Party, is now brimming with the joy and excitement of citizens who greeted the auspicious event of moving into new houses. Against this backdrop, various service facilities are stepping up the preparations for inauguration to contribute to improving the wellbeing of people.
Comrade Kim Jong Un visited the Misan Automobile Technology Service Center first.

He appreciated that all components of the service center are arranged impeccably to fully meet the convenience of customers and ensure the level of specialization as it has modern equipment and comprehensive repair service system necessary for technical service for different vehicles, and plans to provide various car parts and other goods to satisfy the tastes of customers.

Noting that the Misan Automobile Technology Service Center is the second of its kind in the Hwasong area, built under the Party's policy of steadily pioneering and expanding in various forms and ways new service categories for rapidly improving the material and cultural welfare of the people, he said that the center should contribute to promoting the business and cultural life of agencies and enterprises at all levels and the working people through its specialized technical and repair service activities.
Then he visited the Hwasong Pet Shop.
He saw various species of pets on the first and second floors of the shop.

As the households rearing pets are increasing in the capital city and local areas nowadays, I saw to it that a new shop was built to sell pets and various accessories and offer the specialized service, he said, giving instructions on some issues arising in management and veterinary service.
Referring to the production of various kinds of pet-care tools, feed and veterinary medicines, he stressed the need to take measures to increase production in the future.
Comrade Kim Jong Un visited the Hwasong Musical Instruments Shop and looked round its exhibition areas.

He appreciated that the shop ensures convenience in service by presenting age-specific musical instruments of various kinds and different items for fans, students and professional players and applying a new exhibition mode.

Saying it is very important to raise the level of specialization in different categories of service like all other fields and realms of cultural life, he stressed the need to create various service categories capable of satisfying the people's ever-growing material and cultural demands in the arrangement of service facilities and focus on raising the level of specialization.
Then he learned about the preparations for operation of new hairdresser's and beauty parlor.

Saying that welfare amenities are essential for ensuring a cultured and hygienic environment and highly civilized living space in the formation of urban districts, he called for steadily improving the quality of service on the principle of fully meeting the aesthetic tastes and convenience of the inhabitants.

Noting that it is a responsible undertaking, as important as a huge construction project, to manage and operate the leisure facilities well so that they would serve as a valuable foundation for the development of socialist civilization, now that such assets for the people are increasing, he clarified the important tasks for creating a new Korean-style service culture.

Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly encouraged the service workers in Hwasong Street, hoping that they would achieve successes in their activities with the viewpoint on sincere service for the people. He gave an instruction on opening the service facilities on the occasion of the significant Day of the Sun. -0-

49556b157a734e84ece18f5503013865.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Chinese FM
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 11 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, met Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and foreign minister of the People's Republic of China, on a visit to the DPRK, on April 10.
Present there was Kim Song Nam, member of the Political Bureau and secretary of the WPK Central Committee and director of its International Department.
Also present were Wang Yajun, Chinese ambassador to the DPRK, and Hua Chunying, vice-minister of Foreign Affairs of the PRC.
Comrade Kim Jong Un gladly received Wang Yi and exchanged warm greetings and had a talk with him in a comradely atmosphere.
At the talk, Wang Yi courteously conveyed the warm greetings from Comrade Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee and president of the PRC, to Comrade Kim Jong Un.
Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed deep thanks for it and asked the Chinese foreign minister to convey his greetings to Comrade Xi Jinping.

Comrade Kim Jong Un said that it is important for the DPRK and China to further intensify the visits and contacts at different levels and boost mutual support and cooperation for the protection of the common interests and the multi-faceted and sustained development of the bilateral relations, in view of the present international geopolitical situation and the long-term strategic interests of the two countries. And he expressed the stand of the WPK and the DPRK government on the issues of regional and international situation of mutual concern.

Wang Yi expressed the steadfast stand of the Chinese party and government to successfully develop the China-DPRK friendly relations, which have greeted a new phase of development in accordance with the important common understanding reached at the summit meeting and talks between the top leaders of the two countries held in Beijing last September, in keeping with the desire and interests of the peoples of the two countries, and the view on the regional and international issues.

Affirming that it is the steadfast stand of the WPK and the DPRK government to place the greatest value on, give top priority to and further develop the DPRK-China friendly relations with socialism as their core, Comrade Kim Jong Un said that the WPK and the DPRK government would fully support all the internal and external policies of the Chinese party and government for realizing the territorial integrity of the country on the basis of the "one-China" principle and building a fair and just multi-polar world.

Comrade Kim Jong Un exchanged warm farewells with Wang Yi, wishing the Chinese party, government and people greater success in the course of accomplishing the cause of socialist modernization and national prosperity under the outstanding leadership of Comrade Xi Jinping. -0-

bb7eed2ff8e68fbd98904e5733fa45bc.title: Destroyer Choe Hyon Conducts Test-fire of Weapon Systems
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 14 (KCNA) -- The test-fire of strategic cruise missiles and anti-warship missiles was conducted again in the operational efficiency test system of destroyer Choe Hyon of the Navy of the Korean People's Army on April 12.
Comrade Kim Jong Un, together with leading officials in the field of national defence and commanding officers of the Navy, observed the test-fire.

The test-fire was aimed at checking the launching control line of the warship's integrated weapon commanding system and familiarizing the seamen with the missile firing action, as well as confirming the accuracy and the rate of hits of the improved active anti-jamming navigation system.
Two strategic cruise missiles and three anti-warship missiles were test-fired from destroyer Choe Hyon.

The launched strategic cruise missiles flew for 7 869s to 7 920s and anti-warship missiles for 1 960s to 1 973s along the flight orbits set in the sky above the West Sea of Korea and struck the targets with ultra-precision hit accuracy.
On the same day, Comrade Kim Jong Un heard a report on the examined formation plan of weapon systems for the destroyers Nos. 3 and 4 under construction and made an important conclusion.

He expressed great satisfaction over the fact that the preparedness of our army's strategic action has been strengthened in a qualitative way with various achievements recently made in the field of defence science.

Saying that it is our Party's invariable national defence line and most important priority task to steadily and unlimitedly bolster up the powerful and reliable nuclear war deterrent, he clarified the important tasks for further strengthening the strategic and tactical attack capability, a key component of the nuclear war deterrent, and for improving and sophisticating the prompt response posture. -0-

bedcdbe77cf7394b69f2d3dcedc24ba9.title: Artillery Firing Contest of Artillery Sub-units Held on Significant Day of Sun
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 16 (KCNA) -- Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw an artillery firing contest of artillery sub-units under the large combined units of the Korean People's Army in the western area organized on April 15, the Day of the Sun.

Comrade Kim Jong Un was greeted on the spot by No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the KPA, Kim Song Gi, director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, and other commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and military and political commanding officers of the KPA large combined units in the western area.
The artillery firing contest was conducted according to the contest rules set up in conformity with the simulated tactical environment.

In the contest, the artillery sub-units powerfully demonstrated their militant marksmanship they have consolidated to the full with a high desire to perfect combat preparations, and clearly showed their full war posture.
The artillery sub-unit of the Capital City Defence Corps won the first place in the contest.
The 4th Corps of the KPA came second, the 2nd Corps third, the 8th Corps fourth and the 3rd Corps fifth.

Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed satisfaction over the fact that the artillery firing contest, held to mark the greatest auspicious holiday of the nation, served as an important occasion in enhancing the training enthusiasm of our artillerymen and remarkably strengthening their militant might.

The positive utilization of the artillery force is the most important factor deciding the victory in operation and battle and furthermore in war, he said, stressing that the People's Army should as ever put spurs to the artillery combat readiness, true to the Party's policy of attaching importance to the artillery and strengthening the artillery force and that the Party Central Committee's strategic plan for modernization of the artillery force should be thoroughly implemented within the new five-year plan for the development of the national defence.

He said that it is good to frequently organize training contests at all levels of the army on national holidays and other major occasions as seen today and the People's Army should be engrossed only in the training for rounding off the combat preparations, adding that it is precisely the way for realizing the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung's desire for building a powerful army and an expression of loyalty to the Party, the revolution, the country and the people and the duty of the army.
The sub-unit which won the training contest was awarded a diploma, medal and badge.
That day, Comrade Kim Jong Un met the soldiers of the successful artillery sub-unit and appreciated their high combat capability before having a photo session with officers and men.

The KPA commanding officers and artillerymen, blessed with the warm love and trust of the great brilliant commander on the auspicious spring holiday of April, hardened their pledge to devotedly defend the Party Central Committee and reliably safeguard the inviolable sovereignty and dignity of the glorious DPRK and the honor of the Korean People's Army with remarkable success in strengthening the combat power of the artillery. -0-

8b3c27da60e250c290e6f7e47ed5ad5b.title: DPRK Missile Administration Test-fires Tactical Ballistic Missiles
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 20 (KCNA) -- The Missile Administration of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea conducted a test-fire on April 19 to evaluate the power of warhead of the improved surface-to-surface tactical ballistic missile Hwasongpho-11 Ra.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the DPRK, supervised the test-fire.

Among the spectators were Kim Jong Sik, member of the Central Military Commission of the WPK and first vice department director of the WPK Central Committee, Full General Jang Chang Ha, general director of the Missile Administration, Lieut. General An Yong Hwan, commander of the 1st Corps of the Korean People's Army, Lieut. General Ju Song Nam, commander of the 2nd Corps of the KPA, Lieut. General Jong Myong Nam, commander of the 4th Corps of the KPA, and Lieut. General Ri Jong Guk, commander of the 5th Corps of the KPA.
The purpose of the test-fire is to verify the characteristics and power of cluster bomb warhead and fragmentation mine warhead applied to the tactical ballistic missile.

Five tactical ballistic missiles, launched towards the target area around an island about 136 km away, struck the area of 12.5~13 hectares with the very high density, fully displaying their combat might.

Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed great satisfaction over the test results, saying that the development and introduction of different cluster bomb warheads can meet the operational demand of the KPA in a more satisfactory and effective way and that it is of weighty significance in military actions to boost the high-density striking capability to quell a specific target area as well as the high-precision striking capability.

He appreciated that the technology and records we have acquired and updated today are a valuable result of clearly proving that the organization of a group specializing in research into missile warheads and the five years spent for it were not in vain.

He encouraged the defence science research groups, hoping that they will continuously make successes in the important undertakings to acquire and update various ultra-modern technologies necessary for the combat preparedness of our army. -0-

8d6b408c161f186ed2c1f152416602ca.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Pays Congratulatory Visit to Combined Unit under KPA Mechanized Infantry Division in Western Area
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- The elite combat ranks, who are consolidating in every way their matchless war capabilities in the vanguard of building a powerful army while powerfully demonstrating the noble name of a symbolic unit of the heroic Korean People's Army which has creditably carried forward the revolutionary spirit of Paektu and the tradition of invincibility, greeted the moment of glory to be shined forever in its history.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, paid a congratulatory visit to a combined unit under the KPA mechanized infantry division in the western area on April 25, the founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army, and encouraged its officers and men.

The service personnel were full of great excitement and joy to have at their unit the Supreme Commander, whom they have been eager to see even in their dreams in the days of the glorious military service, on the significant day when the DPRK's revolutionary armed forces made the historic first stride with bayonets of self-reliance.

When Comrade Kim Jong Un arrived at the headquarters of the combined unit, all its officers and men broke into stormy cheers of "Hurrah!" with the highest respect for him, the iron-willed commander who is ushering in a new era of building a rich country with a strong army in which the revolutionary cause of Juche pioneered with arms and its steady advance are reliably guaranteed by the strongest military strength.

Comrade Kim Jong Un was greeted on the spot by commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK including Minister No Kwang Chol and the military and political commanding officers of the KPA mechanized infantry division in the western area and its combined units.
Officers presented fragrant bouquets to Comrade Kim Jong Un, reflecting the unanimous reverence of all the service personnel for him.
Comrade Kim Jong Un laid a bouquet at the monument to field guidance of the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung standing in the unit and paid tribute to it.
He visited the revolutionary museum after looking round with deep emotion the monuments to the sacred exploits of the peerlessly great men in leading the army.

He said that the mechanized group with its sacred name and its subordinate units are the glorious ranks organized under the deep trust of the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung hoping that they would take the lead in the vanguard of the whole army in reliably defending the Party and the revolution, the country and the people by carrying forward the brilliant traditions of the anti-Japanese war. The proud history of the anti-Japanese guerrillas who won only victories is reflected in the names of units, he added.

The combined unit is situated in the historic place where the slogan of defending the Party Central Committee unto death was put up first in the entire army and the Red Flag Company Movement started, he said, adding this is the first place where the faith of our revolutionary armed forces to preserve the ideological lineage and carry it forward took roots.

It is our Party's invariable idea of building a powerful army and its outlook on war that making soldiers ideologically elite is a treasured sword for invincibility, he said, stating that the only army strong in ideology, always aware of its lineage and root, can resolutely contain and frustrate any formidable enemy.

Stressing that the combined unit, intensively associated with the chronicle of guidance of the great leader Comrade Kim Il Sung and the great leader Comrade Kim Jong Il over the Party's army, should be a model of the entire army in conducting the political and ideological work for soldiers and perfecting combat preparedness in conformity with its characteristics and position, he clarified the tasks to this end.
Comrade Kim Jong Un had a photo, to be recorded forever in the army-building history, taken with all the officers and men of the brigade significantly greeting the founding anniversary of the KPRA.
On the same day, he watched sports games with the service personnel of the unit.
The service personnel were full of boundless joy, pride and excitement as they significantly spent the happy holiday in the presence of the Supreme Commander.

All those officers and men, who received great affection and the highest honor of having Comrade Kim Jong Un at their unit on the significant day when the historic roots of our revolutionary armed forces were taken, pledged to creditably carry forward the sacred mission, ideal and indomitable fighting spirit of the army-founding generation and thus add shine to the KPA's glorious history of victory. -0-

a1551caf7cb344f239cd05faa67bfe81.title: Firing Contest of Mortarmen under KPA Large Combined Units Held to Mark Significant April 25
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 26 (KCNA) -- A firing contest of mortarmen of light infantry units under the large combined units at all levels of the Korean People's Army took place on April 25, the 94th founding anniversary of the Korean People's Revolutionary Army.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, oversaw the firing contest.

Among the spectators were No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Ri Yong Gil, chief of the General Staff of the KPA, Kim Song Gi, director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, and other commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence and military and political commanding officers of the KPA large combined units.

The firing contest was conducted in the way of judging combat methods of the sub-units that are to rapidly conquer the natural and artificial interception lines, maneuver and deploy and destroy different targets within a set time and then hide and get away from the place according to their tactical missions.
Strikingly demonstrated in the contest were the high militant effectiveness and power in the use of mortars by shock troops of the light infantry units at all levels and their full war posture.
Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed great satisfaction over the results of the contest.

He extended warm encouragement to the units participating in the mortar firing contest, who significantly commemorated the birthday of the KPRA, an especially significant holiday for our state and revolutionary armed forces, with proud training success for perfecting the combat preparedness, and to the officers and men of the entire army. He highly appreciated that the enthusiasm for effecting a revolution in the training to enhance the combat efficiency is nowadays growing stronger in the army units at all levels.
The mortar sub-unit under a combined unit of the 11th Corps of the KPA won the first place in the firing contest.
The 2nd Corps of the KPA came second, the 91st Corps third, the 1st Corps fourth, the 4th Corps fifth and the 5th Corps sixth.

Comrade Kim Jong Un said that the combat drill should be organized and conducted with the main emphasis on bolstering up in every way the combat capability to completely destroy the enemy by thoroughly embodying the WPK's military strategic idea and all the requirements of the Juche-oriented tactics. And he gave detailed instructions on the development of training contests among units at all levels and among core and sub-units of the entire army in a more intensive and competitive way. -0-

0f10009ee3e10964a940430cc00aea10.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Speaker of State Duma of Russian Federation
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Sunday met Vyacheslav Volodin, speaker of the State Duma of the Russian Federation, on a visit to the DPRK to attend the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.
He warmly greeted Vyacheslav Volodin and had a friendly talk.

Volodin courteously conveyed the best congratulations and wishes from Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, to Comrade Kim Jong Un, President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed deep thanks for it and asked Volodin to convey his warm greetings to the esteemed Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin.

Warmly welcoming the visit of the official delegation of the Russian Federation to the DPRK, he highly appreciated that it is an expression of the stand and will of the Russian leadership to attach importance to and consolidate the relations of alliance between the two countries that Comrade President Putin sent a high-level delegation led by Vyacheslav Volodin to the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.

It was a historic event proving the mightiness and firmness of the DPRK-Russia alliance that the armies and peoples of the two countries fought shoulder to shoulder and won a victory in the operations for liberating Kursk, he noted, adding that the current visit of the Russian official delegation would be an important occasion in boosting the feelings of friendship and unity between the peoples of the two countries to a new high level.

Vyacheslav Volodin said that it is his honor to take part in the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations today and express his heartfelt thanks once again to the DPRK soldiers, who died in the sacred struggle to liberate the Russian territory from the Ukrainian Nazi forces, and their bereaved families. And he stressed that the Russian people would always remember the feats of the DPRK people and soldiers who provided fraternal assistance to liberating Kursk.

The talk reaffirmed the will to develop the DPRK-Russia relations in a comprehensive way in line with the spirit of the treaty on comprehensive strategic partnership and thus promote the national interests of the two countries and the wellbeing of the two peoples.
The talk proceeded in a warm and trustworthy atmosphere. -0-

a00a7c94e73e1e1ec2f3d4ba051b33cd.title: Memorial Concert Given for War Martyrs at Overseas Military Operations
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- A memorial concert "Stars of the Motherland" for the war martyrs, excellent sons of the glorious Democratic People's Republic of Korea, was held outside the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations, built as a monumental edifice in the great era, on Sunday evening.

The venue of the concert, where a group sculpture of heroic soldiers involved in the special military operations of the Korean People's Army is standing imposingly to show the political and ideological mightiness peculiar to our army, was wrapped in an atmosphere of mourning the heroic soldiers cherished deep in the hearts of the country and the people as eternal stars.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the memorial concert, together with leading officials of the Party, government and armed forces organs, officers and men of the overseas operations units, bereaved families of the martyrs and other participants in the inauguration ceremony.

Present there were Vyacheslav Volodin, speaker of the State Duma, Andrei Beloussov, minister of Defense, and other members of the official delegation of the Russian Federation and staff members of the Russian embassy here.

Put on the stage of the concert, which began with orchestral music "Morning Star" and narrative poem "Immortality", were hymns full of deep respect for and recollection of the warriors involved in the overseas military operations and famous songs on patriotism.

The performers paid the highest tribute to the proud sons, combat heroes in the era of Kim Jong Un who created the immortal myth of strong army at the cost of their lives by demonstrating to the full the excellence and bravery of the DPRK and its people through their indomitable heroic struggle in the overseas special military operations, true to the order of the country, and returned to the motherland they longed for even in their dreams.

Watching the numbers showing the days and months of life-and-death bloody battles filled with obligation and decisive battle, blood and tears and indignation and revenge, and pathetic scenes of death-defying hand-to-hand fights and heroic suicidal explosions the young soldiers chose without hesitation, the audience keenly felt with painful resentment and grim resolution what a dear price the soldiers have paid for the dignity of the strong and immortal fame.

The audience were deeply moved by the emotional scenes showing the lights from the window of the Party Central Committee that never went down, wishing for the safety of the soldiers in the alien battlefield, and the world of parental love and agony of the great father who repressed hard the great pain of loss upon receiving every sad news and wrapped them in the sacred national flag to glorify their precious lives shining like stars though they fell down, to epically prove how the Koreans and the Korean People's Army are strong and ever-victorious.

The audience enthusiastically sang with the performers "Eternal Reverence" and "Only Victory" and other famous songs that arouse the strong will to cherish the immutable truth of patriotic loyalty and immortality, taught by the shining names, images and heroic lives that will never be mossed with time, and build without fail a thriving country, the world's most powerful country desired by the martyrs.
Also put on the stage were Russian famous songs.

The memorial night was heated by the bitter sorrow and heartache being jointly overcome on the road for justice and peace and the militant friendship and peculiar feelings that have laid foundations for the eternal development of the DPRK-Russia friendship.
The concert ended with the playing of national anthems of the DPRK and the Russian Federation.
Air echelons of the KPA Air Force flew over Saeppyol Street, setting off fireworks in reverence for the representatives of the precious honor of the country.

The memorial concert wishing that the passionate pulse and spirit of the great heroic soldiers, who defended the dignity and honor of the motherland at cost of their lives, embodying the DPRK's absolute strength and symbolizing its people's mightiness and justice, would be eternal as the breath of the DPRK and its army and people, had deep resonances for the audience. -0-

a37cea8a3097f3c23e2a683d38b630f4.title: Dinner Given for Official Delegation of Russian Federation
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- The State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea hosted a dinner on April 26 in welcome of Vyacheslav Volodin, speaker of the State Duma, Andrei Beloussov, minister of Defense, and other members of an official delegation of the Russian Federation who participated in the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.
The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, was present at the dinner.

Present there on invitation were members of the official delegation of the Russian Federation, Vladimir Topeha, charge d'affaires ad interim of the Russian embassy here, Alexei Bartusov, defense attaché, and staff members of the embassy.
Leading officials of the WPK Central Committee and members of the DPRK State Affairs Commission were on hand.
At the dinner, Jo Yong Won made an important speech in welcome of the official delegation of the Russian Federation.
The dinner proceeded in a friendly and cordial atmosphere. -0-

b50e9c0ec286a23fac3464f466399610.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Meets Russian Defense Minister
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, on Sunday met Andrei Beloussov, minister of Defense of the Russian Federation, on a visit to the DPRK to attend the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.
He gladly received the Russian defense minister and had a warm and friendly talk with him.
Andrei Beloussov courteously conveyed the warm greetings from Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin to Comrade Kim Jong Un.
Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed deep thanks for it and asked Andrei Beloussov to convey his comradely greetings to the esteemed Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin.

Warmly welcoming Defense Minister Beloussov's visit to Pyongyang at a meaningful time, he said that just one year ago the DPRK units and the Russian armed forces waged a joint struggle to annihilate the armed gangs, who invaded the border area of the Russian Federation, and achieved brilliant war results in liberating Kursk. And he expressed his pleasure to do the sacred undertaking to perpetuate the history of the joint struggle, together with the Russian friends, on the occasion of the day.

Saying that Defense Minister Beloussov's visit to the DPRK on behalf of the military leadership of the Russian Federation further enhances the political significance of the inauguration of the memorial museum of combat feats, he expressed thanks to the Russian leadership for its sincerity for the development of the relations of alliance between the DPRK and Russia.

Defense Minister Beloussov expressed his pleasure to take part in the historic inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations, saying that the matchless heroism and bravery displayed by the excellent sons of the DPRK will remain forever in the history of militant friendship between the armies of the two countries.

Exchanged at the talk were broad views and opinions on the issues of mutual concern including the daily-aggravating international and regional situations. And the talk discussed a series of issues for further consolidating and developing the political and military cooperation and assistance between the two countries.

The DPRK government will as ever fully support the policy of the Russian Federation to defend the national sovereignty, territorial integrity and security interests, Comrade Kim Jong Un said, expressing belief that the Russian army and people would surely win a victory in the just sacred war. -0-

c4a4c5d4d21c29d912fdcadee81ff6ba.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un's Speech at Inauguration Ceremony of Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un made a speech at the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.
The full text of his speech is as follows:
Officers and combatants of the overseas operations units of the Korean People’s Army, who are here by accomplishing a sacred mission and earning invaluable honour,
Officers and soldiers of the People's Army,
Bereaved family members of the martyrs,
Citizens of Pyongyang,
Soldier-builders, officials and creative workers, who have wonderfully completed this important and responsible construction project,
Members of the official delegation of the Russian Federation on a visit to Pyongyang to share this significant moment with us, as well as dear friends,
Comrades,

Today we are holding the ceremony of inaugurating the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations that will tell forever the heroic feats and ennobling spirit of the proud sons of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, who sacrificed their precious lives in the sacred battles for justice and dignity.

Our motherland has built a monument in the capital city, which the combatants so dearly cherished in their hearts and always respected, to honour their precious lives and soul, and is greeting the moment of embracing them.
Everyone of this country has waited for this day.

As the bereaved family members, seeing here within hailing distance, have waited for the day when their beloved ones would be embraced, the comrades-in-arms of the martyrs, all the officers and soldiers of our army and all the people of our country have longed to see the place where they will lay flowers to wish for the martyrs' immortality, appreciating with infinite ennobling feelings the heroic and precious features of our army they did not fully realize in the past.
Thanks to this ardent wish and sincerity, this museum, where the martyrs will live forever as true and proud sons of their country, has been built.

Thus has been achieved my wish to bring back all our officers and soldiers, who dedicated their precious lives too early, cover their bodies in the national flag and bury them in their motherland, the wish of other officers and soldiers of our army, as their comrades-in-arms who performed military service with them while braving the hail of bullets and gunfire, to pay their warm respect to them and the wish of all other people, as citizens of this country, to offer gratitude and honour to their defenders.

On behalf of the Workers' Party of Korea and the government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, I extend heartfelt thanks to the officers and soldiers of the construction units of the army at all levels and officials and creative workers of the relevant units, who have devoted unsparing efforts and wisdom for the construction of this museum in reflection of the earnest wish of all the people of the country and the officers and soldiers of the entire army to add lustre to the precious lives of the martyrs for all eternity.
I offer my thanks to the dear comrades of the delegation of the Russian Federation who are here with the feelings of warm tribute and solemn obligation from the people of the fraternal country.
Comrades,
Today marks the first anniversary of the end of the operations for liberating Kursk.

The soldiers of Korea and Russia, who are faithful to the ideal of justice, fought in the same trench shoulder to shoulder to defend peace and national sovereignty, and achieved a result decisive in checking the resurrection of fascism and frustrating the hegemonic forces' ambition for a war.
The operations were military activities conducted in one region in a few months, but the strategic significance of the result is very great.

Justice and injustice have always co-existed in the whole history of mankind, and the confrontation between them has been acute all the time. But there has been no such a situation as that of today in which the forces of domination and tyranny attempt to destroy the desire for national sovereignty and freedom, after they emerged brazenly on this planet as the most shameless and aggressive ultra-rightist reactionary alliance, discarding any sleazy mask or veneer.

In the rigorous and crucial years when the undoubted demand of a country and a nation for its rights to political self-determination and development and the implementation of its obligations have become the target of tyranny, the armies of the DPRK and Russia demonstrated the strength of justice through their bloody struggle, fully aware of the noblest duties they have assumed for their countries and mankind.

The soldiers of the two countries have clearly proved that there does exist in the world a tremendous might capable of overturning the society of evils created by imperialism, by dint of the hearts afire with justice and death-defying strength, and that the tyranny of injustice can never conquer mankind.
In the course of this, the fine sons of the two countries have set examples of true friendship and dedicated their precious blood for the common aim.
There will be neither more sacred contribution nor more correct expression of obligation than sacrificing one's life.

In the sacred war to wipe out the Ukrainian armed invaders who blatantly violated the sovereignty and security of the Russian Federation, our fraternal country, and liberate the Kursk region, the overseas operations units of our Korean People's Army won the priceless victory by displaying matchless bravery, mass heroism, indomitable fighting spirit and noble self-sacrificing spirit.

Thanks to the valiant struggle of the Korean People's Army that repulsed and wiped out the aggressors, shoulder to shoulder with the Russian army, the hegemonic attempt and military adventure pursued by the United States and the West were frustrated.

Standing before us are the war heroes, who should line up here most honourably, with the national flag of dignity and glory in their hands, full of indomitable soul and faith which did not burn even in the flames.
Now everyone knows full well for what they dedicated their youth on the alien battlefields.
But it is scarcely known how each of them fell in what circumstances, for what they wished at the last moment of their lives and what requests they left.
To our remorse, we could not portray every detail of their last moments here.
Probably there will be no museum in the world which can exhibit such loftiness, purity and beauty without regret.
Our soldiers who had been inconspicuous, plain and simple in ordinary days demonstrated their merits most clearly in battles.

The powerful resistance and undaunted offensive they persevered with against all odds and to their death, their trait of not giving up executing the orders till the last moment of their lives, their matchless self-sacrificing spirit of bravely facing death and their heroic choice at the moment of life and death - all these were so unprecedented and legendary that they struck us with wonder before striking the world with wonder and that even the wartime generation would admire.
Every one of those ennobling sacrifices became a valuable stepping stone in the hard-fought battles for our army to hasten the day of liberation.

The symbolic monument at this museum is not a portrayal of a specific martyr; it represents the soldiers of the Korean People's Army, every one of whom is brave, and all the martyrs, who are heroes epitomizing the spirit and mettle of Koreans.
The world of a hero does not find expression in any distinguished feat alone, and heroic behaviour does not come out of any spontaneous impulse.
The fierce battles in the Kursk region were an extension and part of the service by our army for the Party, the revolution, the homeland and the people.
Their deaths were also a moment of the service.
They were all loyalists, patriots and genuine men no matter where they were killed and how.

They must have never imagined they might leave their country even once. They must have taken arms pledging to become a handful of dirt of their homeland when they had to die. However, they unhesitatingly went to the battle sites in a foreign country where their bodies could not be retrieved if they were killed. And when crossing the border they hardened their resolve to execute the orders at the cost of their lives, far from thinking about their native homes, parents, wives and children that became far away. This is too lofty to explain merely with the soldiers' sense of obligation.

As the photos and relics on display here in this museum show, none of them, though they were in an alien country, forgot the Party nor lived separated from the embrace of their homeland even for a moment.

The national flag they would look up to with a solemn feeling before charge while praying for the safety and prosperity of Pyongyang and swearing to defend the homeland, the pouch of soil from the homeland each of them kept in his chest as a reminder of its warmth, the letters they wrote requesting to believe that they would remain honourable before their homeland which had given life to them, as well as before their parents, wives and children, even though they could not return home alive, the letters of pledge that they would implement the orders at the cost of their lives and the blood-stained letters they wrote applying for admittance to the Workers' Party of Korea - these tell many stories about their praiseworthy choices and heroic deaths.

As they could not live separated from their country and they were inseparably bound with it in destiny, they did not expect any compensation, though they performed distinguished feats, nor any reward for their self-sacrifice through self-blasting.

They left only the request for carrying out the order given by the Party, as they fell in action shedding blood, and prayed only for their country's prosperity shouting "Long live Pyongyang!" as they died a heroic death.

What desire, if any, they had was to remain remembered by the Party and the country and, even if they failed to be remembered, they had no greater pride and happiness, if they could feel the self-satisfaction that they accomplished their combat missions given by the Party and the pride that they dedicated their all to the motherland.
Their final moments lasted for some minutes or some seconds, but that brief moment clearly highlighted their pure loyalty to the Party and the country and their maxim of true service.
The self-sacrifice expecting no compensation and the devotion expecting no reward - this will be the definition of the height of loyalty of our army.
Such pure-hearted loyalty comprises the root of extraordinary heroism, the sacred oath, the will to punish the enemy and the personality of the strong who regard even death as their honour.

As they were so loyal to the Party and the country, they could have the undying courage and the strength of charge far surpassing the law of human physiology, opt for their last that the world still fails to understand and display the scenes of laying down their lives for their comrades-in-arms.

The overseas military operations of our army were unheard-of activities conducted by the service personnel who upheld the order of the Party and the country not only according to the military discipline and morals of obedience and execution but also with their voluntary conscience and moral rights, the most sincere and beautiful men who burned their hearts with pure, strong loyalty and overcame the extreme limits with its infinite viability.
There was neither distinction between arms, duties, ages and military ranks nor difference between Party members and youth league members in their spiritual strength and feats.
The participants in the military operations lived in the world of heroes before becoming heroes after death and in the noble spiritual world of Party members before becoming Party members.

Not only the heroes who unhesitatingly opted for self-blasting, suicide attack, in order to defend the great honour, but also those who fell in the vanguard of charges and those who writhed in frustration at the failure to fulfil their duties as soldiers who were given orders, rather than in pain in their bodies torn by bullets and shells, cannot but be called the soldiers faithful to the Party, patriots.

It is said that for soldiers in battlefields, nothing is more honourable than feats and victories, but what is more sublime and valuable is the pure conscience dedicated to their Party and country and firm faith in them.

Our combatants knew that after they fell in action, their dead bodies might be left at the mercy of the wind blowing through the snow-covered forests in the alien land. However, they sacrificed their lives as they believed that their greatest honour was to contribute to implementing the orders and add to the prestige of their great country. If one tries to measure such an ideological feeling, both pure and beautiful, only with the yardstick of certain exploits, one will be underrating so many admirable soldiers' true feelings of love, tears and priceless sacrifices.
They are sons of our Party and our country, who, though fighting at the other end of the earth, could identify the roots of their lives only with such feelings of love and loyalty.

That is why we honour such intense loyalty to the Party and the country and the noble sacrificing spirit stemming from the loyalty - rather than any outstanding military exploits or feats - as symbols of our army's fighting efficiency and our country's heroism.
The memorial wall in this museum can be called an emblem of immortality for the martyrs who, though dead and gone, will live forever as shining examples for their fellow countrymen.

Glorifying the imperishable lives of the martyrs and their unchangeable soul, the stars on the memorial wall shine brightly day and night, and they will teach people the truth of immortality and help them understand the position and significance of this museum.
This museum is a colossal fortress in which the souls of these loyalists and their hearts burning with patriotism rest, as the whole world can see.
As a decoration dedicated to this land by our admirable sons, such a museum could not be set up even at a cost of millions of tons of gold.

As time passes, this museum will continue to bring the heroes closer to all the coming generations of our Republic, and our army's successors will warmly embrace the combatants, adding one page after another to the history of patriotism and loyalty lest their sacrifices be brought to naught.
The country supported by patriotic and loyal defenders will remain powerful and great for all ages.
Today's inauguration ceremony will be recorded in a page of history as a sacred event that has injected absolute immutability into our state's inviolable dignity and prestige.
Comrades,
In this museum we have recorded a new chapter in the history of DPRK-Russia friendship that was written in blood, the history of justice that was achieved at the cost of blood.
This symbolizes the steadfastness of succession and our will.
Our future is certain.

In order to defend national sovereignty and interests in the current rapidly-changing times, we should keep turning into a formidable rival to the enemy and we should unite and grow stronger to become formidable.

As I have mentioned on several occasions, we should develop ours into a genuine, devoted and powerful stronghold, always coping in united efforts with any crises irrespective of the time and place of their occurrence and of any change in the rules of war.
Peoples of the two countries aspiring after independence, dignity, peace and prosperity are desirous of this, and the history of fidelity and unity written in blood indicates this.
As that immortal group sculpture of the soldiers of the two countries shows, the times expect us to be always ready, to be able to devote ourselves and to be resolute like them.

In front of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations born with our history of resolution, history of justice and obligation, we get firmer in our determination towards the future.
Comrades,
Our army will continue to fight bravely for the dignity and honour of its motherland, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.
Along with the history of defence we are writing with the sacred sense of mission and fortitude, this museum will shine in the world and the martyrs will live forever in the brilliant rays.
Sincerely hoping that the precious lives of our people's proud sons, great soldiers, will shine forever, I declare the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations open. -0-

fb95edbc1ee6e88d6efa16a9dbade164.title: Inauguration Ceremony of Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at Overseas Military Operations Solemnly Held
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 27 (KCNA) -- The magnificent memorial museum of combat feats was erected in the best place of the capital city to praise the great heroic spirit of the brave Korean People's Army soldiers involved in overseas military operations who created the legend of miraculous victory unprecedented in history with ardent patriotism and loyalty to defend the sacred prestige and dignity of the DPRK.

The immortal edifice, which will convey forever the ideological and moral superiority, popular heroism and unrivalled bravery peculiar to the KPA displayed in the special military operations to liberate Kursk Region of the fraternal Russian Federation with the sacred mission and duty, is a symbol of the most righteous people and the strongest army of the DPRK and a great monument giving eternal vitality to the development of the DPRK-Russia relations forged and being consolidated at the cost of blood.

Comrade Kim Jong Un has put on the highest place of glory the excellent sons of the country who performed immortal exploits before the times and history and the generations to come with their noble sacrifices and heroic military feats. He energetically led the whole construction course of the memorial museum from its design and construction work to the arrangement of contents of combat feats and the creation of symbolic memorials so that the names and images of the war martyrs can shine forever as a group of eternal stars.

The monumental edifice, which shows the traces of life in battlefields and remarkable military achievements, made by the officers and soldiers of KPA overseas operation units, and their passionate pulsation and noble soul through the highest architecture and careful artistic portrayal, is associated with the boundless sincerity, reverence and noble moral obligation of our Party and government and our people and service personnel for the brave war soldiers, and it represents the heroism of our times and the invincibility of our cause.

An inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations was solemnly held on April 26, the first anniversary of the conclusion of the operations to liberate Kursk of the Russian Federation.

Pervading the ceremony venue were deep respect for and remembrance of the heroic war soldiers who had been unfailingly faithful to the orders of the country and dedicated their lives without hesitation to the dignity and honor of our great state.

The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, attended the inauguration ceremony.

Present there were Jo Yong Won, Jo Chun Ryong, No Kwang Chol, and other senior Party, government and military officials, commanders of the KPA large combined units, officers and men of the overseas operations units and engineering unit, the bereaved families of the war martyrs, leading officials of the ministries and national agencies, the soldier-builders and creators who contributed to the construction of the museum, students of revolutionary schools, youth and students and citizens of Pyongyang.

Attending the ceremony were also Vyacheslav Volodin, speaker of the State Duma, Andrei Beloussov, minister of Defense, and other members of the official delegation of the Russian Federation and staff members of the Russian embassy here.

When Comrade Kim Jong Un arrived at the venue of the inauguration ceremony, all the participants broke into cheers of emotion, looking up to him, the peerlessly illustrious commander and great father who has trained the KPA into a politico-ideologically strong army without parallel in the world and into an invincible revolutionary army winning every battle and puts the lives of the heroic soldiers on the highest place of immortality with his noblest love and obligation.

Comrade Kim Jong Un met brigade and battalion commanders of the overseas military operations units who participated in the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.

He gave warm militant encouragement to all the commanding officers of the overseas operations units who fully demonstrated the outstanding fighting spirit and bravery peculiar to the KPA through skillful combat command and made contributions to glorifying the mightiness and inviolable authority of our state.

Looking up to Comrade Kim Jong Un embracing every one of the reliable commanding officers who advanced through the fierce gunfire in the van and giving warm paternal affection, the participants extended enthusiastic applauses.
The national anthems of the Russian Federation and the DPRK were played.
Comrade Kim Jong Un made a significant speech in commemoration of the inauguration.

Expressing his deep emotion to have the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations erected by the wish of all the KPA service personnel and the ardent desire and sincerity of the people across the country, he extended heartfelt thanks on behalf of the Party and the government to the officers and men of the construction units at all levels, officials of the relevant organs and creators who devoted their all efforts and wisdom to the construction of the museum.

He referred to the strategic significance of the operations for liberating Kursk, in which the armies of the DPRK and Russia faithful to the ideal of justice fought shoulder to shoulder in the same trench for peace and sovereignty, and to the unrivalled bravery, mass heroism, indomitable fighting spirit and noble sacrifice displayed by the DPRK people's excellent sons in the bloody battles to set a model of the militant fraternity.

He said that the overseas military operations of the KPA were the ones without parallel in history as they were conducted by the servicepersons who implemented the orders of the Party and the country with their own conscience and moral rights, the most sincere and beautiful persons who burned their hearts with pure loyalty and went beyond the limits with their infinite vitality, adding that today's inauguration ceremony will be recorded in the history as the one that gave absolute immutability to the dignity and reputation of our state.

He affirmed that the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations will shine all over the world and the martyrs be immortal in its bright rays, along with the biographies of defense written with the sacred sense of mission and toughness. Then he declared the inauguration of the museum, sincerely wishing that the precious life of the great servicepersons would shine forever.

All the participants kept in mind with great emotion that the noble spirit and mettle of the martyrs would be immortal enjoying the respect of rising generations thanks to the benevolent care of the great leader ensuring that the images and names of the martyrs, who dedicated their lives to the sacred war of justice, are etched in golden letters on the immortal monument.

Then, Vyacheslav Volodin, speaker of the State Duma of the Russian Federation, read out a letter from Comrade Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin, president of the Russian Federation, to the participants in the inauguration ceremony of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations.

In the letter, President Putin extended congratulations on the inauguration of the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations in Pyongyang on the occasion of the first anniversary of the liberation of Kursk and expressed his sincere gratitude and high respect to those involved in the Kursk liberation operations and the fallen heroes, saying that the unprecedented feats the KPA service personnel performed by displaying their outstanding bravery and genuine spirit of self-sacrifice while fighting shoulder to shoulder with their Russian comrades-in-arms, will remain forever in the hearts of all the Russian citizens.
Minister of National Defence of the DPRK No Kwang Chol and Russian Minister of Defense Andrei Beloussov cut the inauguration tape.
A large number of white balloons flew up, reflecting the noble reverence for the heroic sacrifices and great exploits of the excellent sons of the DPRK people.
A ceremony of burying the remains of the war martyrs in the overseas military operations was solemnly held.

No Kwang Chol said that our precious officers and soldiers, whom we neither wanted to send nor lose, finally came to the warm embrace of the motherland they had so longed for and wanted to return even at their last moments, adding that their precious desire and faith as well as their undying feats will be preserved forever by the unanimous will and steadfast struggle of all the service personnel and people.

Comrade Kim Jong Un covered with earth the remains of martyr Kim Son Chol, hardly repressing his pain of loss and regret of not being able to bring back to life the genuine patriots and brave and passionate revolutionaries who sacrificed themselves unhesitatingly upon the call of the country.

Guards of honor of the KPA covered the remains of the martyrs with earth, praying for the souls of the great sons of the DPRK people and for immortality of the most genuine soldiers and the most genuine human beings.
Comrade Kim Jong Un recollected with reverence the last heroic moments of the brave soldiers who devoted their precious lives to the dignity and honor of the great motherland.

Amid the playing of music "Song about the Country", the historic moments passed to convey the world of noble love and obligation of the great father who, as the heaven of destiny embracing the stars of loyalty, gives the everlasting pulse of life to the martyrs who failed to return and takes care of the destiny and future of their kinsmen.

The bereaved families were in tears of emotion, looking up to Comrade Kim Jong Un who is grieving over the young heroes, who wished nothing but only the prosperity of the country and dedicated their lives, even though he provided the house of immortality pulsating with their souls and breath that cannot be mossed with time, beside the homes of the bereaved families who have just started to lead a happy life amid the respect and blessing of all the people.

Comrade Kim Jong Un once again paid warm tribute to the bereaved families who are regarding the noble life and glorious death of their beloved sons and husbands as proud and honorable and strongly overcoming the grief over the loss of the most precious persons.

A volley of rifles was fired, in reflection of the noble respect for the brave soldiers who showed through their admirable patriotic deeds how the KPA soldiers should live for the Party and the country and what they should leave before the country and brought invincibility of the heroic Korea to a higher level.
A wreath in the name of Comrade Kim Jong Un was laid at the Monument to the Korean People's Army Martyrs in the Special Military Operations.
Wreaths were laid in the name of the speaker of the State Duma and the minister of Defense of the Russian Federation.

And placed were wreaths in the name of the Central Committee of the WPK and the Central Military Commission of the WPK, the State Affairs Commission of the DPRK, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly of the DPRK, the DPRK Cabinet, the Ministry of National Defence of the DPRK and the three services of the KPA.

All the participants observed a moment's silence in memory of the war martyrs, the proud sons of the DPRK people who created a new history of great victory and indomitable heroic feats, to be immortal, for the country and the revolution and all the generations to come in the sacred war for defending justice, dignity and peace.
Comrade Kim Jong Un went round the museum together with major members of the official delegation of the Russian Federation, and senior party, government and military officials.

He laid a flower before the memorial wall where the war martyrs, who demonstrated the great appellation of the strong and the glory of victors with their loyalty to the Party and the country, ardent patriotism and popular heroism peculiar to the KPA, are shining as immortal stars, and paid high tribute to them.

Also laid there were flowers presented by members of the official delegation of the Russian Federation, senior party, government and military officials, the bereaved families of the martyrs and other participants in the ceremony.

Comrade Kim Jong Un looked round with deep emotion the photos and exhibits showing the boundless loyalty to the order of the country, ardent patriotism and the indomitable mettle with which they greeted even death as glory to defend the honor of the strong, which all the generations of the DPRK should keep forever and carry forward.
He visited rooms where the remains are enshrined and laid a flower before them.

He affirmed that the dignified figures standing in the front ranks of the KPA can not be seen again, but the soul and spirit of the martyrs, the defenders of the precious honor of the country, will serve as the symbol of the heroic spirit of the DPRK people and the banner of the mightiness of our army and powerfully encourage the victorious advance of the peoples of the two countries struggling for the common cause of independence and justice.

He went to the room of visitor's book and wrote: "The soul of the martyrs will be eternal along with the great honor they defended although their lives are buried with the earth with which they fought in their bosoms.
I would like to present 'the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations', the platform of honor, to the proud sons, officers and soldiers of this country.
Kim Jong Un
Speaker of the State Duma Vyacheslav Volodin and Minister of Defense Andrei Beloussov of the Russian Federation made entries in the visitor's book.
Comrade Kim Jong Un went round the exhibition hall of captured arms at the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats.

He expressed belief that the museum wishing for immortality of the war martyrs, who defended the dignity and safety of the fraternal peoples at the cost of their precious blood, proved the militant friendship between the DPRK and Russia and the solid fraternal relations of alliance between the two peoples and raised the dignity, honor and pride and glory of our generation to be admired by the coming generations, would shine forever as the house of national treasure of Juche Korea and the monument to the great alliance embodying the strong will and power of the two peoples aspiring after justice and peace.

Looking round the sanctuary of education in patriotism associated with the feats of the heroes who made a dash in response to the orders of the country and resounded with the echo of their beautiful life left by them at the last moments, all the participants hardened their firm will to build a prosperous state and the most powerful country in the world the martyrs desired so ardently, always remembering their noble soul and ambition.

The burning soul of the war martyrs will be immortal with the prestige and eternal prosperity of the DPRK, to be strong for all ages, along with the Memorial Museum of Combat Feats at the Overseas Military Operations symbolizing the greatness of the DPRK people and bearing witness to the era of Kim Jong Un, the most heroic era of the DPRK. -0-

ed837659be139bc515f98b29337bb4fd.title: Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Enjoys Concert Marking 80th Founding Anniversary of Central Military Band of Ministry of National Defence
paragraphs: Pyongyang, April 29 (KCNA) -- The respected Comrade Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, enjoyed a concert commemorating the 80th founding anniversary of the Central Military Band of the Ministry of National Defence on April 28.

Since it made its debut in the opening ceremony of the Pyongyang Institute, founded as a base for training military and political cadres of the country after the liberation of Korea, the Central Military Band of the Ministry of National Defence has made proud achievements in the history of development of the heroic Korean People's Army, upholding the Party and the country and powerfully encouraging the whole army to victory with the revolutionary military music pulsating with the spirit of the times and the strong army.

Among the audience were No Kwang Chol, minister of National Defence of the DPRK, Kim Song Gi, director of the General Political Bureau of the KPA, and other commanding officers of the Ministry of National Defence, officials of the WPK Central Committee, officials of ministries and national agencies and institutions and enterprises in Pyongyang, creators and artistes of military and civilian art troupes and service personnel.

The concert began with the solemn playing of the national anthem of the DPRK. Its performers played the stirring melodies of the revolutionary military music filled with the militant spirit to powerfully demonstrate the course of development of the heroic KPA, which has defended the vigorous advance of the ever-victorious Juche revolution under the leadership of the WPK and reliably guaranteed the invincibility and mightiness of our state.

The concert was acclaimed by the audience as it impressively showed the deep ideological and moral world and the will of loyalty of the service personnel to add eternal luster to the honor of the KPA, which has always been faithful to the orders of the country and the sacred appellation the army of the Party and the people and won legendary victories and created tales of miracles.

Comrade Kim Jong Un congratulated the performers on their successful performance, praising them for giving an excellent concert pulsating with the revolutionary character and militant spirit of our army.

He said that the shining history of the KPA is clearly associated with the feats of the Central Military Band of the Ministry of National Defence as it has displayed the tremendous might incomparable with any military hardware, encouraging the brave and heroic army with the revolutionary military music decade after decade. He added that he has always paid respect to the military band as a group of soldiers representing the revolutionary army, not as an art troupe.

Comrade Kim Jong Un highly appreciated that the Central Military Band of the Ministry of National Defence is the face of our state and symbol of the KPA, saying that wherever the military music resounded, there were the stirring scenes of those displaying matchless courage and bringing about the epoch-making changes.

He said that the creators and players of the military band should have boundless loyalty to the Party, the country and the people and high artistic ability and encourage the advance of the KPA with their revolutionary military music. And he had a photo session with all the creators, players and officials, expressing belief that the Central Military Band would always remain faithful to its most honorable mission.

The members of the Central Military Band of the Ministry of National Defence extended boundless gratitude to Comrade Kim Jong Un who is giving great trust and warm blessings, glorifying the band's honorable 80-year history of following the Party, and made a firm determination to usher in a new heyday of development of the revolutionary military music, powerfully encouraging the vigorous historic advance of the army and people of the DPRK for implementing the decisions of the Ninth Congress of the WPK with thunderous military music. -0-
